document_title: EES Gemini v0.9.1 Controlled Internal Pilot Approval
decision: APPROVED FOR CONTROLLED INTERNAL PILOT ONLY — NOT CERTIFIED FOR PRODUCTION
scope: Use by authorized internal testers in a non-production, least-privilege environment. Do not expose to external users, process sensitive production data, or enable unrestricted command/file access.

checks.name: Structural validator
checks.evidence: Run immediately before packaging: structurally_valid; 32 skills; 74 capabilities; 222 evaluation contracts; 51 central fixtures; 13 operational fixture projects; zero warnings.

checks.name: Routing audit
checks.evidence: Run immediately before packaging: zero errors and zero warnings.

checks.name: Operational fixtures
checks.evidence: Existing project report records 13 passed, 0 failed, 0 timed out; this does not evaluate agent effectiveness.

checks.name: Focused regression suites
checks.evidence: Previously recorded focused suites passed; individual additional test files passed. Full suite did not complete in the available environment.

checks.name: Full pytest suite
checks.evidence: Timed out before completion. Some individual test modules also timed out when run separately; full-suite success is not claimed.

checks.name: Live Gemini integration
checks.evidence: No live Gemini CLI/API run or provider-credential validation was performed.

checks.name: Independent security review
checks.evidence: No independent penetration test or OS-level sandbox verification.

approval_conditions: Internal testers only; isolated non-production environment.
No unrestricted shell or destructive actions without human approval.
Record test failures and incidents; stop pilot if unexpected file access or command execution occurs.
production_release_blockers: Complete the entire pytest suite in clean CI and resolve timeouts/order-dependent hangs.
Run supported live Gemini integration tests.
Complete human semantic review of all 32 canonical skills.
Complete independent security review and validate runtime sandbox boundaries.
limitations: This is an internal scoped authorization, not a third-party certificate, regulatory certification, or production approval.
No claim is made that the suite is more intelligent or effective than the underlying model.
